Class PropertyGraph<T>

java.lang.Object
gate.lang.property.PropertyGraph<T>
public class PropertyGraph<T> extends Object
Precompiled graph of nested Property paths used to materialize object trees from a flat property source.

A graph is built from property names such as "role.name" or "items[0].id" and then resolved recursively. Leaf properties obtain their value from the supplied Function<Property, Object>, while intermediate nodes are materialized through ConstructionStrategy.

This means partial updates follow the construction model of each target type:

  • beans reuse or create an instance and apply only the provided attributes;
  • builders receive only the provided attributes;
  • records, constructors and static factories receive null for missing attributes.
As a result, immutable nested objects may be rebuilt from the provided subset, while mutable anemic objects preserve attributes that were not present in the graph.
